description: This file defines a Python class 'Code128' for generating Code 128 barcodes, including encoding, validation, and decomposition methods. It includes barcode pattern mappings and configuration options for barcode dimensions and quiet zones.

classes.name: Code128
classes.description: A class for creating and encoding Code 128 barcodes, supporting different code sets, validation, and barcode pattern decomposition.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the barcode value, ensuring all characters are within the ASCII range or specific control characters.

methods.name: _trailingDigitsToC
methods.description: Optimizes encoding by converting trailing digit sequences into Code C for double density.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the barcode value into a sequence of barcode patterns, applying set switching and optimization.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Converts the encoded barcode into a string of pattern representations for rendering.
